changeSet.author: nathp
changeSet.comment: Rename legacy traceAuthorType field to authorType in trace snapshots stored in feedback.associations JSON.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE feedback SET associations = jsonb_set( associations::jsonb, '{traces}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN jsonb_exists(trace_element, 'traceAuthorType') THEN (trace_element - 'traceAuthorType') || jsonb_build_object('authorType', trace_element -> 'traceAuthorType') ELSE trace_element END ) FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element ) ) WHERE associations IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(associations::jsonb, 'traces') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element WHERE jsonb_exists(trace_element, 'traceAuthorType') );

rollback.comment: No rollback needed: authorType is the current field name read by the application.

changeSet.author: nathp
changeSet.comment: Between the isGroupe revert and its re-application, trace snapshots stored in feedback.associations JSON carried a boolean author type. Convert it to the ETraceAuthorType enum, with the same mapping as the trace.author_type migration (true: COLLECTIVE, false: PERSONAL).
changeSet.sql: UPDATE feedback SET associations = jsonb_set( associations::jsonb, '{traces}', ( SELECT jsonb_agg( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(trace_element -> 'authorType') = 'boolean' THEN trace_element || jsonb_build_object( 'authorType', CASE WHEN (trace_element ->> 'authorType')::boolean THEN 'COLLECTIVE' ELSE 'PERSONAL' END) ELSE trace_element END ) FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element ) ) WHERE associations IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(associations::jsonb, 'traces') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(associations::jsonb -> 'traces') AS trace_element WHERE jsonb_typeof(trace_element -> 'authorType') = 'boolean' );

rollback.comment: No rollback needed: the enum value is the format read by the application.
